{{DISPLAYTITLE:Titania (''Tactics Advance'')}}
[[File:FFTA - Titania Portrait.png|right]]
[[File:FFTA-spr-titania.gif|left]]
{{Quote|Powerful sprite. Wields holy magic.|Description}}
The '''Titania''' in ''[[Final Fantasy Tactics Advance]]'' is a powerful enemy that belies its elegant appearance. Its Attack power is high, even surpassing [[Malboro (Tactics Advance)|Malboro]] and [[Red Panther (Tactics Advance)|Red Panther]]. Its Holy-elemental spells protect its allies and decimate its enemies. Titania has Auto-Float status.
